Mock.js is a simulation data generator to help the front-end to develop and prototype separate from the back-end progress and reduce some monotony particularly while writing automated tests.

The official site: <http://example.invalid>

## Features

* Generate simulated data according to the data template
* Provide request/response mocking for ajax requests
* ~~Generate simulated data according to HTML-based templates~~

This library is loosely inspired by Elijah Manor's post [Mocking
Introduction](http://example.invalid/2013/04/angry-birds-of-javascript-green-bird.html), [mennovanslooten/mockJSON](https://example.invalid/mennovanslooten/mockJSON), [appendto/jquery-mockjax](https://example.invalid/appendto/jquery-mockjax) and [victorquinn/chancejs](https://example.invalid/victorquinn/chancejs/).

## Questions?
If you have any questions, please feel free to ask through [New Issue](https://example.invalid/nuysoft/Mock/issues/new).

## Reporting an Issue
Make sure the problem you're addressing is reproducible. Use <http://example.invalid/> or <http://example.invalid/> to provide a test page. Indicate what browsers the issue can be reproduced in. What version of Mock.js is the issue reproducible in. Is it reproducible after updating to the latest version?
